definitions.explanation: A rat that climbs well and nests high up in buildings, in ceilings and attics. Now the main pest rat in the office buildings of Japanese cities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天井裏|てんじょううら}→天井裏：23106_tenjouura⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{熊鼠|くまねずみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{住|す}み{着|つ}いた。
examples.english: Black rats have settled in the space above the ceiling.

examples.japanese: クマネズミ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{所|ところ}→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧だ。
examples.english: Black rats are good at climbing to high places.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、ドブネズミ⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧クマネズミ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: In city buildings, damage from black rats is increasing more than damage from brown rats.

notes:
Usually written in katakana, クマネズミ, as animal names are in science and pest-control writing.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ドブネズミ: brown rat; larger, lives low down in sewers and drains
- ハツカネズミ: house mouse; much smaller
- ネズミ: rat or mouse in general
